lines.text: Got it, no need to explain.

data.mean: Got it, no need to explain.
data.define: Used to say you agree and need no more details.

misuse.text: Don't say 'say less' when you need details.
misuse.why: It tells them to stop explaining.

publish.title: What does "say less" mean?
publish.value: Say less = Got it, no need to explain. Example: "Free snacks? Say less!" (very casual English, US).
